solution.title: Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard & Premium) — Unified Audit Log & Investigations

products.name: Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard & Premium) — Unified Audit Log & Investigations — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement Purview Audit — unified audit logging on, Standard vs Premium understood, retention policies + SIEM export configured, and search/investigation runbooks — so you can answer what an incident asks. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn on and use Purview Audit for real investigations

When something happens, you need the audit trail — and most orgs discover too late that it wasn't configured. This solution implements Purview Audit: ensure unified audit logging is on, understand Standard vs Premium (retention, high-value events like MailItemsAccessed, longer retention policies), build audit search + investigation workflows, wire retention policies and SIEM export, and validate you can answer the questions an incident will ask — before it asks them.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — unified audit log, Audit Standard vs Premium (events, retention, high-value logs), search/investigation, retention policies, and SIEM export.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensing for Premium, Audit roles, SIEM/export targets, retention requirements).
  • Implementation Guide — confirm/enable unified audit, configure Audit Premium + retention policies, build search + investigation runbooks, wire export, and validate an investigation scenario — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (auditing on, high-value events captured, investigations answerable) plus Best Practices for investigation-ready auditing.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An audit trail ready before you need it — unified logging on, high-value events captured and retained, investigation runbooks in hand — so an incident finds answers, not gaps.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVAUDIT-Discovery.ps1 — Purview Audit configuration + retention + licensing assessment (read-only)
    • PURVAUDIT-Export.ps1 — Office 365 Management Activity API content subscriptions helper (read-only default)
    • PURVAUDIT-Report.ps1 — audit coverage + investigation-readiness scorecard (read-only)
    • PURVAUDIT-Search.ps1 — paged unified audit log search / investigation helper (read-only)
    • PURVAUDIT-Set-RetentionPolicy.ps1 — enable unified audit + create/update/remove audit retention policies (-WhatIf default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
